# Confirm session recovery never changes saved milestones

## What & Why
Session status is intentionally separate from reviewed profile sync and application milestones, but the end-to-end browser flow should lock that boundary down. A regression here could make reconnecting a session alter saved opportunity status or profile details.

## Done looks like
- Seed a profile and opportunity with a known status
- Export/import a session status through the extension and cockpit
- Confirm profile fields, answer library entries, opportunity details, and milestone status are unchanged

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/assist.spec.ts
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
- browser/application-assist/popup.js
